summary: Defined the identity model (gateway, participant, user) and the error model as versioned protocol schemas. New schemas: gateway.schema.json (unique gatewayId + registration-token model, Relay rejects unregistered/suspended/revoked gateways per SP-02, token fingerprint only, never the secret), user.schema.json (local Edge accounts, passwordVerifier is an Edge-local-store-only PHC field never transmitted), and error.schema.json (stable UPPER_SNAKE codes, reserved catalog in $defs.errorCode, retryable hint; single source of truth for common.$defs.error used by delivery FAILED and sync/API responses). Participant now links to the gateway and user records (gatewayId for system gateways, userId for humans). 65 schema fixture checks pass (Draft 2020-12); protocol.md Phase 0 identity/error-model task ticked.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: PROTOCOL-0.3 — Define the identity model (gateway, participant, user) and error model. Authored three new versioned Draft 2020-12 schemas: error.schema.json (error model + reserved error-code catalog referenced via common.$defs.error), gateway.schema.json (Edge Gateway identity/registration record with registration-token and signed-request-token $defs; Relay stores only a SHA-256 fingerprint, SP-07), and user.schema.json (local Edge user with PHC passwordVerifier that must never be transmitted). Wired the identity model together: participant.schema.json gained optional gatewayId (system gateways) and a userId link to user.schema.json; syncbatch.gatewayId now references the Gateway identity record. Documented both models in schemas/README.md and ticked the protocol.md Phase 0 checkbox. Added 22 fixtures (7 error, 7 gateway, 8 user) and registered the new schemas in tests/schemas/validate.mjs. Validation: 65/65 schema fixture checks pass; secrets scan finds only field names/spec text/fake fixtures (SP-07).
